args.code: (()=>{const allText=document.body.innerText;const events=allText.match(/\[第\d+天\][^\n]+/g)||[];const todayEvents=events.filter(e=>e.includes('[第88天]')||e.includes('[第')&&e.match(/\[第(\d+)天\]/)&&parseInt(e.match(/\[第(\d+)天\]/)[1])>=88);const skillMatch=allText.match(/技能[\s\S]*?等级|作物熟悉度|田地管理|工具精通|堆肥/);const npcMatch=allText.match(/村民[\s\S]*?好感|张婶|周珠珠|赵老板|老渔夫|王村长|林小雨|王二蛋|陈阳|李老农|孙妙青/);return JSON.stringify({eventTotal:events.length,todayEvents:todayEvents.slice(-10),lastEvent:events.slice(-5),hasSkills:!!skillMatch,hasNpcs:!!npcMatch});})()
